job_spec.name: hbm_smh_front_s_vq-933923316-tc-hm25-cl
job_spec.purpose: Full NC8 south-front gated-result consumer: fault qualified by own-column valid, complete row requires all valid, partial vector faults explicitly. RESULT_VALID=0 legacy unchanged; 0 cycles and no arithmetic change. Re-hardening required before gated die adoption.

calibrate.cmd: TTB=$(ls -d /srv/opentallas-scratch/claude/ttbatch/26f14af32 /home/ubuntu/closure-loop-local/ttbatch/26f14af32 2>/dev/null | head -1) && export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 $TTB/tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; python3 tools/hbm_accel_smh_physical.py block --piece front_s --top-param REQCR=1 --top-param RESULT_VALID=1 --variant one --pd 0.55 --grt-allow --period 770 --skew 90 --die-skew 150 --hold-margin 0 --hold-buffer-pct 60 --no-admit --cores {THREADS} --src {SRC} --label {LABEL}_cal --out {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}_cal --stop-after cts --lat-ff 100 && bash {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}_cal/run.sh

route.cmd: TTB=$(ls -d /srv/opentallas-scratch/claude/ttbatch/26f14af32 /home/ubuntu/closure-loop-local/ttbatch/26f14af32 2>/dev/null | head -1) && export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 $TTB/tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; python3 tools/hbm_accel_smh_physical.py block --piece front_s --top-param REQCR=1 --top-param RESULT_VALID=1 --variant one --pd 0.55 --grt-allow --period 770 --skew 90 --die-skew 150 --hold-margin 25 --hold-buffer-pct 80 --no-admit --cores {THREADS} --src {SRC} --label {LABEL} --out {RUN}/routes/{LABEL} --lat ${CK_SS_MEAN:-720} --lat-ff ${CK_FF_MEAN:-430} && bash {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/run.sh

hold_eco.reexport: docker run --rm -v {SRC}:/src:ro -v {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}:/work openroad/orfs:asap7lock bash -lc 'mkdir -p /work/views; for c in ss ff; do /OpenROAD-flow-scripts/tools/install/OpenROAD/bin/openroad -no_init -exit /work/abstract_$c.tcl || exit 1; done' > {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/abstract_eco.log 2>&1
